evidence.quote: A VideoCardz source confirmed that one board partner already has RTX 50 Super GPUs on hand
evidence.one_line: An unnamed VideoCardz source said one board partner already has RTX 50 Super GPUs in stock.
evidence.speaker: VideoCardz unnamed source

evidence.quote: Nvidia has allegedly told the company that the products are on hold because of the price of 3GB GDDR7 memory chips
evidence.one_line: Nvidia reportedly told a board partner that RTX 50 Super products are on hold because of 3GB GDDR7 memory pricing.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia (reported)

evidence.quote: Nvidia used to supply VRAM chips alongside GPU dies to its board partners, but it changed this policy in late 2025 as the memory chip crisis unfolded.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia reportedly stopped supplying VRAM chips with GPU dies to board partners in late 2025, so partners must source memory themselves.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (reporter)

evidence.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.one_line: SK hynix says 2027 will be the worst year for the memory shortage and that the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.speaker: SK hynix

evidence.quote: with the company not announcing a new GPU at CES 2026
evidence.one_line: Nvidia announced no new GPU at CES 2026, the first time in five years.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (reporter)

evidence.quote: memory accounting for 25% of the BOM, as costs have soared by nearly 500%
evidence.one_line: Memory reportedly accounts for 25% of the bill of materials for Nvidia's latest AI systems, with costs up nearly 500%.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (reporter)

evidence.quote: these chips cost twice or thrice as much as their 2GB variants
evidence.one_line: The reporter says 3GB GDDR7 chips cost two to three times as much as 2GB variants.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (reporter)

candidates.question: Will Nvidia launch RTX 50 Super GPUs by the end of fiscal 2027 (2027-01-31)?

rungs.label: Yes
rungs.condition: Nvidia officially launches at least one RTX 50 Super GPU on or before 2027-01-31

rungs.label: No
rungs.condition: No RTX 50 Super GPU is officially launched on or before 2027-01-31

candidates.settled_by: Nvidia official product announcement or launch record
